collections.name: Pop Art Portraits
collections.description: Pop-inspired portrait cross-stitch designs that share one colour palette.
collections.description_es: Retratos de inspiración pop que comparten una misma paleta de color para combinar distintos diseños dentro de la colección.
collections.description_en: Pop-inspired portrait cross-stitch designs that share one colour palette, making it easy to combine different designs within the collection.

products.title: Bubble Gum Portrait
products.short_description: A playful pop portrait with a bold pink bubble-gum focal point. Beginner-friendly full cross stitch, 100 × 120 stitches and 19 DMC colours.
products.description:
Bubble Gum Portrait is a modern digital cross-stitch pattern built around warm neutral portrait tones and a vivid pink bubble-gum accent.

The 17-page PDF includes a finished-design preview, pattern facts, a 19-colour DMC key with stitch counts, full-colour and black-and-white chart overviews, four enlarged colour chart sections, four enlarged symbol chart sections, and a print-and-stitch guide.

Pattern details: 100 × 120 stitches; 7,927 total stitches; 19 DMC colours; full cross stitches only; beginner friendly. Finished area: 18.1 × 21.8 cm on 14 ct, 15.9 × 19.1 cm on 16 ct, or 14.1 × 16.9 cm on 18 ct Aida.

This is a digital PDF pattern. No physical item is shipped. Personal use only.
